about.bio:
Highly motivated and results-oriented Full-Stack Web Developer with expertise in MERN stack technologies and cloud services (AWS). I design, develop, and optimize scalable web applications, with hands-on experience spanning system architecture, database schema design, and end-to-end feature delivery.

At Tricog Health, I've led the development of a cardiac care platform from scratch, migrated a legacy Angular admin portal to the MERN stack, and built microservices for audit logging, OCR extraction, and real-time health data integration with devices like Apple Watch and Omron monitors.

I'm looking to leverage strong technical skills and problem-solving ability to drive impactful solutions in a challenging engineering environment.

highlights: Led the end-to-end development of the Tricare platform from scratch, including system architecture, database schema modeling, and feature implementation.
Spearheaded the migration of the Atlas Admin Portal (TLAS) from Angular to the MERN stack, improving dashboard performance and maintainability.
Architected secure authentication and authorization flows with AWS Cognito for role-based access control across the TCC platform.
Integrated Omron, Agora, and Exotel APIs for real-time health data sync, video calling, and click-to-call functionality.
Optimized backend APIs and system architecture, reducing response latency and improving scalability under increasing load.
Mentored junior engineers through structured code reviews and technical sessions.
